book.name: 2 YONI
book.title: YONI ꞌINA ꞌETOLADI ꞌELUWENA Yoni ꞌina leta gete solanaya ꞌiemwasala oboboma be eꞌita palupaluna manudi.

content: ꞌAboꞌagu ꞌimi ꞌenaꞌi, ta ꞌoyo waine Yaubada ꞌiesinuwemu manatumwao ꞌemiya leta gete yaꞌetoladinawa. Onaꞌaiꞌaila, yaobobomemi sinabwana. Nadigega wate taudi ꞌeda ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌana tomuliyao siobobomemi,
manuna mwalatoi ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌatedaya ꞌimiyami be ꞌedaya ꞌida miyaataya.
ꞌEnega Tamada Yaubada be Natunana Yesu Keliso ꞌidi oboboma be ꞌidi ꞌatenuwaꞌoleꞌole ꞌediyega tada miya siwalowa, ma ida ona ꞌaiꞌaila, be wate ma ida eobooboboma.
Lowa ꞌaidi natumwao yaꞌitedi ꞌeda palupaluna simulimuliye, nadigega ꞌada loina Tamada ꞌenega, ꞌenega yagwausowala sinabwana.
Nuugu ye, yasideyo wate gete nigeya ꞌaene loina auwauna yaꞌebwaꞌebwaꞌeyo, ta esi loina kadekadelina nina wagimi nononaya ꞌaene maiboꞌada tada eobooboboma.
Manuna ꞌeguma taeobooboboma, nate Yaubada ꞌina loinao tamulimuliyedi, ta loina nina lowa wanononaya ꞌaene oboboma ꞌina ꞌeda ꞌenega tada tauya.
Ta tokabo yaudi niꞌatu siapwesa baleꞌuya ga sieyaseyase, sigwae, “Yesu Keliso nigeya ꞌieetomota.” ꞌEguma yaita nadigega ꞌikaboꞌesa, tauna Keliso ꞌana talauwala.
ꞌEnega tokabo nidi ꞌediyega wada ꞌitaꞌiꞌisimi, be ꞌimi guinuwa ꞌana pali geyaꞌabo waloseloseye, ta esi maiboꞌana waꞌewa.
Ta ꞌeguma watauya gesi be Keliso ꞌina eꞌita wapilisine, ꞌomi Yaubada wamiyamiya sine, ta esi ꞌeguma Keliso ꞌina eꞌitao wagiyai ꞌiꞌisidi, Tamadai be wate Natunana ꞌemiya simiyami.
ꞌEnega ꞌeguma yaita ꞌemiya ꞌiwawai ta ꞌina eꞌita dumadumana, geyaꞌabo wabwaubwauye ꞌimi anuwaya nai walokagutokiye,
ꞌabona nai ꞌina guinuwa nina toꞌumalina walemeleme.
Yage yauna simiyami be nuwanuwagu manudi yaꞌetoladiwa, ta tuwa, manuna yanuwayaina ꞌaene maꞌetamo yada wai be ꞌomi maꞌegwao tada ꞌawagwae, be ꞌenega tada egwausowala ꞌaiꞌaila.
Tasiyo tauna wate esiesinuwana Yaubada ꞌenega, natunao ꞌidi oboboma ꞌemuya.
